#################### DSSP3_1 dataset Description ###############################################
#         DSSP3_1 is a secondary structure datasets with three states H=(H,G,I), E=(B,E), and  #
#         C=(T,S,C). There are 17608 Non-Redundant chains (25%). This dataset was created by   #
#         DSSP & Blastclust. PDB resolution is maximum 3 Angstrom and PDB chain length is minimum 
#         80 amino acid. There are three line in each PDB, First line is PDB ID with chain,    #
#         Second is amino acid sequence in single letter code,                                 #
#         and third line is assignment of  above three states H, E and                         #
#         C secondary structure at each amino acid residue corresponding to amino acid of      #
#         respective PDB  sequence, where, H=alpha helix, B=a beta bridge, E=Extended beta     #
#         sheet, G=3/10 helix, I=pi helix, T=hydrogen bonded turn, S=bend, C=coil.             #
#################### Dataset Description end    ################################################
